# Shahid Prime Travel and Tours (SHAHID PRIME SERVICES)

> Business setup, Commercial Registration (CR), MISA licensing, PRO services, VAT/ZATCA and accounting, plus visa consultancy, Umrah visas and airline ticketing. Based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Owner: Shahid Bashir. CR No. 7052788051. Hours: 10:00–22:00 daily. Markets served: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, UAE.

## Business Setup in Saudi Arabia

- [Business Setup in Saudi Arabia](/business-setup-saudi-arabia): Company formation, LLC registration, MISA investment licence, CR, VAT and banking.
- [Business Setup in Jeddah](/business-setup-jeddah): Local Jeddah consultancy for company registration and PRO work.
- [CR Provider](/services/cr-provider): Commercial Registration issuance, renewals and amendments.
- [PRO Services](/services/pro-services): Iqama, work permits, Naqal Kafala, Qiwa/Muqeem/Absher, family visas.
- [VAT & Accounting](/services/vat-accounting): ZATCA VAT registration, e-invoicing, bookkeeping, Zakat, corporate bank accounts.

## Travel & Visa Services

- [Services Hub](/services): All offerings.
- [Visit Visa](/services/visit-visa): Schengen, global visit visas and work permits.

- [Umrah Visa](/services/umrah): Umrah visa processing.
- [Saudi Khidmat](/services/saudi-khidmat): Wakala, Naqal Kafala, Azad Visa, Amal Manzali.
- [Airline Ticketing](/services/airline-ticketing): International and domestic tickets.
